text:
Mei: Sync: planning A/B rollout for the orchestrator shim that preserves LangChain session ids so routing + model pinning behave during canary. Need owners for tech post, SI runbook, perf sign-off.
Arjun: I can own the shim PR and the upstream adapter example. Found a bug where session id gets dropped on reconnects over http2. Patch in PR: github.com/redwood-inference/adapters/pull/402
Priya: Perf note: sim shows p95 increases ~120ms when KV namespace is global vs per-conn at 50 concurrent sessions. We should recommend sticky-cache for SI with heavy KV reads. CSV: s3://rwd-partners/orch-shim/bench-2013456789.csv
Noah: For A/B plan: group A=existing routing, group B=shim-enabled. Start 2% traffic B, monitor token cost, tail latency, and quality scores for 48h. If metrics stable, ramp 2x every 24h.
DevOpsBot: Canary policy created: policy-id=canary-2026-2013456789. Auto-rollback triggers: p95 latency +20% or error-rate > 0.5%.
Mei: SI enablement asks: short runbook (deploy, smoke, rollback), terraform snippet for routing, and a debug checklist for session mapping. Priya/Arjun please collaborate.
Arjun: Terraform snippet (draft):
```
resource "redwood_gateway_route" "lc_adapter" {
  name = "lc-adapter"
  meta = { copy_session_to = "x-routing-key" }
}
```
Priya: QA: add a CI e2e that simulates reconnects and validates KV namespace continuity. I'll add tests to the adapter repo.
Marketing: I'll draft the partner-facing note: conservative language, "interop-enabled" and list limitations. Need a one-line customer quote from pilot.
Mei: Action items: 1) Arjun - land shim PR & adapter example, 2) Priya - perf doc + CI tests, 3) Noah/DevOps - schedule canary and monitor dashboards, 4) Marketing - draft blurb. Follow-up sync Wed 9am PT. Keep public announcement clear about caveats.
